_comment: Explicit ROI config for AVSS 2007 footage. Replaces the previous filename-sniffing hack in src/detection.py (roi_polygon only applied if the source path contained the string 'AVSS') with an explicit opt-in: run with `python main.py --source "data/raw/abandoned_objects/AVSS 2007/AVSSS07_EASY.mpg" --config configs/avss_run.json`. The polygon below is the AVSS train-platform-edge safety boundary; it means nothing for any other camera view.
